title: Campaign Reconciliation Report v0
description: One comparison of a CampaignSpec (desired state) against an Admin API readback (observed state). Verdicts are exact-only and the vocabulary is closed. Rows the API cannot observe are classed `unsupported` and COUNTED, never dropped: a report must never present 'nothing to report' and 'nothing was checked' as the same result. Package prices are pre-Offer — the Offers layer that sets effective price has no API surface — so `price_basis` travels with every report. Comparison rules: docs/reconcile-comparison-matrix-v0.md.

outcome.description: Partial or truncated input is always `inconclusive` — never a difference, which would imply a comparison that did not happen.

matrix_hash.description: Hash of the comparison matrix revision these verdicts were produced under.

price_basis.description: Observed package prices are pre-discount. Offers are not exposed by the API, so a `matched` price verdict is a true claim about the CONFIGURED value and says nothing about what a customer is charged.

offers_affect_price.description: True when the spec asserts any offer, meaning configured and effective price provably differ.

coverage_complete.description: True only when every matrix row was evaluated or explicitly classified, input was whole, and no binding was left unresolved. `unsupported` and `not_asserted` rows do NOT reduce coverage — they are accounted.

accounted_row_count.description: Rows classed `unsupported` or `not_asserted`: seen and deliberately not judged.
